LynkOmni shell in a browser Draft design

Interactive emulator of the parts every LynkOmni surface is built from (build section 1). Sample data, sandbox partners, test money only. Not reviewed by a designer yet.

LynkOmni
https://app.lynkomni.com/

Try it

Everything here is the shared shell: the header with the side you are on (your workspace or your Storefront), the navigation that becomes tabs on a phone, the app launcher (grid), the account menu with Change view and Why this view?, language and region (globe), "find or do anything" (search), the help panel, notifications, the connection chip and every screen state. On a touch view, swipe from the edge to open the menu, swipe a sheet down to close it and press and hold a tab for its help; with a keyboard, arrows move inside a group and "/" opens search.

Conditions

The view is chosen automatically from this device (DEVICE rule): . The two controls below are for testing only; real apps always choose automatically.

Notifications

The bell (top right) shows what needs action first, folds repeats, and has filters, actions with Undo and "Why am I seeing this?". An urgent notice breaks through as a banner with sound and vibration and repeats until you tap "I have seen this". The help button (?) holds LynkAssist: ask a question (it answers offline too) or let it fix something with Confirm or Deny. On the home page, try the PIN pad (the right PIN is 2580) and number matching.

Screens

Pick a state to see how the shell shows it. Every state has a picture, a title, one line and a next step: no dead ends.
